lemmas.primary_translation: to turn away / distance oneself / withdraw

definitions.text: snu seg slik at en ikke lenger har framsiden mot noe eller noen
definitions.translation: turn oneself so that one no longer has one's front facing something or someone

examples.no: han vendte seg bort fra de andre et øyeblikk
examples.en: he turned away from the others for a moment

definitions.text: få et mer distansert forhold til
definitions.translation: develop a more distant relationship with

examples.no: i ungdomstiden vendte hun seg bort fra de nære vennene sine
examples.en: in her youth she turned away from her close friends
